segments.title: Part 2: your iCloud Mail
segments.say: Part two: ChatGPT can read your iCloud Mail too. Try these three.
One. Find what people need from you.
segments.text: Which emails ask me to do something?

segments.say: Two. Turn an email into an event.
segments.text: Put Sam's meeting email on my calendar.

segments.say: Three. Draft it, then read it before you send.
segments.text: Draft a reply offering 2 free slots.

segments.title: Before you connect
segments.say: It only sees iCloud addresses, and setup needs an app-specific password.
Save this for Monday's inbox, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
